dedupe_keys.name: swiss railway traction network load forecasting dataset with operational planning context

description: This dataset gives multi-year hourly time series for day-ahead forecasting of the load on the Swiss railway traction power network, the dedicated 16.7 Hz grid operated by Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) that supplies electric trains across Switzerland. The target is the total traction grid load, the net input from power plants, neighbouring networks and frequency converters; covariates come from operational planning (passenger and freight timetables, rolling stock allocation, transport demand indicators) and weather forecasts. The Railway file covers 2018 to 2023 with 56 covariates, including values for four network sectors (West, East, Central, South); the Railway-Agg file covers 2020 to 2023 with 16 national covariates. The network has over 1,800 km of 132 kV and 15 kV lines, 70 substations, 13 power plants and converter stations and 11 frequency converters, and supports more than 8,000 train journeys a day. It was published by researchers of EPFL on 12 March 2026. Coverage is national, hourly. The two CSV files (41 MB and 4 MB) are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the load is national only, and the planning covariates are forecasts, not observations. The data support capacity planning, energy procurement and resilience studies of railway power supply, alongside national rail network data catalogued here.
